text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. I'm really looking forward to my 
classmate's victory party.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Since they said it'll be held in the 
classroom, it might be a good idea to 
suggest some decorations.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
What kind of cake should we prepare? One 
from a famous bakery would be nice, but it 
also sounds fun for everyone to decorate 
it together, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, the flyer I received 
in front of the station was actually for a 
cake shop. Let's take another look right 
away—

With her mind entirely consumed by the 
victory celebration, Mejiro Ardan ended up 
skipping her training.
